invariants.rationale: Method is invoked on data and collectAsList cannot be called on null.
seqOp::apply is used, so seqOp must be non-null.
combOp::apply is used in reduce, so must be non-null.
reduce returns a value, which with a non-null identity (zeroValue) and non-null operators, is never null.
Result comes from reduction seeded by zeroValue and using ops of O, so should be an instance of O.
